ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with high-intensity (white) regions limited to distal tips and lower periphery; approximately 9:1 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation covering the majority of the fluke surface; high-contrast white clusters localized at the left and right distal tips and along the bottom leading edge transition.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 30-40 degrees relative to the vertical midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with jagged peaks and deep valleys across the entire trailing edge; notably sharper peaks on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch extending horizontally and curving slightly upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge; white colonial barnacle clusters present on distal tips.
